en.headline: No own commits; 1 issue comment and 1 reply received
en.summary: On 2026-10-12, `sogeisetsu` recorded **0 own commits** across the tracked window, with all activity concentrated in issue interactions. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, there were 16 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` and no own commits. The single issue activity was a comment on `openchamber/openchamber` issue #4664, titled "[Bug] A skipped-role notice between two replies merges them into one turn, hiding the earlier finished answer inside Activity". No pull requests, reviews, releases, stars, or discussions were recorded. One reply was received on `anomalyco/opencode` issue #51263, where `terry-an-investor` confirmed the Tinyfish provider HTTP 400 failure on v2.0.27 and noted the failure is key-presence-dependent rather than universal.

zh.headline: 本人无提交；1 条 issue 评论与 1 条收到的回复
zh.summary: 2026-10-12 当天，`sogeisetsu` 在统计窗口内共有 **0 次本人提交**，活动集中在 issue 互动上。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 仓库中，共有 16 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交，本人无提交。唯一的 issue 活动是在 `openchamber/openchamber` 的 #4664 上留言，该 issue 标题为“[Bug] A skipped-role notice between two replies merges them into one turn, hiding the earlier finished answer inside Activity”。当天没有 PR、review、release、star 或 discussion 记录。在 `anomalyco/opencode` 的 #51263 上收到一条回复，`terry-an-investor` 确认在 v2.0.27 上 Tinyfish provider 返回 HTTP 400，并指出该失败与 key 是否存在相关，并非普遍性故障。
